scope: Independent narrative, units, retained-case and receipt review; no fits, sampling, hypothesis tests, or accounting reruns.
resolved_findings: Qualified opening safety comparison to the primary 2% distance; development 3% put filters do not improve every accepted-day measure.

review_conclusions: Primary participation, breach and normalized-liability tables agree with saved summaries; no material transcription issue found.
Strike breach is explicitly separated from net losing trades, intraday touches and full-width loss.
Liability and credit percentages use wing width; return and drawdown percentages use account equity; summed daily attribution is not compounded-wealth attribution.
Constant credits and costs are hypothetical and credit-sensitive wealth rankings are disclosed; no attainable option profit or safety guarantee is claimed.
All nine cases, six probability models plus always-sell control, both phases and three credit scenarios remain reported.
Original numerical failure is preserved; the separate replay reports no new fits, resampling, inference, hypotheses or promoted signal.
The 1% condor small-sample breach warning and finite-sampling limitations are disclosed.
Prospective ledger scope is accurately described as implemented scaffolding without active collection, option adapters or calibrated joint-density scoring.
limitations: This review interprets saved verified output and checks receipt hashes; it does not certify live option availability, execution, future calibration, or inferential significance.
